_comment: MIRROR of public.migrations_applied. Not the source of truth -- the table is. Regenerate with scripts/syncMigrationsApplied.ts, and verify-migration-state.sql asserts this file equals the table, so drift is DETECTED rather than silent. That detection is the whole reason a mirror is acceptable at all: the last hand-kept applied-state was wrong about migration 181 within hours.
_recordStartsAtWhy: public.migrations_applied was created by migration 184 and backfilled from 179. Anything numbered below 179 predates the record and is presumed applied -- it has been in production for months. Treating those as unapplied would fail the guard on every column in the schema.
